analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (KRW 61,550) above SMA5 (KRW 58,021), below SMA20 (KRW 67,581): entered short-term uptrend after short-term rise, now below mid-term trend.
· Significantly lower than SMA100 (KRW 112,383) and SMA200 (KRW 113,028): mid-to-long term trend remains weak.
· 52-week position at 11.1%: sideways consolidation near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (38.9→38.6): failed to exit oversold, holding neutral zone, downward pressure remains.
· MACD histogram trajectory (161.0420→161.0420): sideways consolidation continues, no trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band KRW 67,581): band width is wide at 41.65%, consolidating around the mid-band.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support at KRW 61,145: higher support level than Pivot S1 (KRW 47,138).
· Swing resistance at KRW 80,380: potential for short-term rebound if broken, but mid-to-long term trend reversal is uncertain.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low at KRW 51,065): lows are rising, but credibility is reduced due to lack of volume.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio at 0.83x: subdued volume compared to the 5-day average, reducing the reliability of price movements.
· Current phase diagnosis: potential entry into accumulation phase, but maintaining a sell stance due to lack of volume and continued MACD deterioration. If support at KRW 61,145 breaks, a resumption of the downtrend is possible.
